verdict.rationale: Vercel publishes a documented public REST API (OpenAPI spec confirmed at vercel.com/openapi.json), plus a CLI and llms.txt/docs.md machine-readable documentation, enabling programmatic control of deployments, projects, and other resources. This directly supports AI-native driving of the product via API/CLI tooling. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of API completeness/SDK coverage and explicit rate-limit/auth documentation excerpts.
